data.name: International Carbon Registry (ICR)
data.description: International Carbon Registry (ICR) is an Iceland-based ISO-aligned GHG program and carbon credit registry platform that registers climate projects and issues, tracks, and retires carbon credits (including removals). It operates as a registry/standards body in the voluntary carbon market and does not itself remove CO2, nor operate a marketplace.
